answer: In PoA, bonded collateral makes equivocation costly: when evidence links k coordinated identities to conflicting attestations, pairwise penalties scale as P(k)=c·k(k−1)/2, or O(k²). Detection also applies an exponential loss multiplier, exp(λk), to the swarm’s remaining capital through asymmetric depreciation, so splitting stake among identities does not dilute risk. Whether labels are opal, ivory, or sable, each identity remains accountable.
